subject: gk
question: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Guru Bipin Singh - Kuchipudi.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guru Bipin Singh** was a director, choreographer and teacher of Manipuri dance. Singh, the son of a vocalist and a traditional doctor, started dancing and singing as a child before** concentrating on Manipuri dance**, notably under Guru Amudon Sharma and with the help of the **monarch of Manipur.**
 
• He made a living as a** film choreographer**, but he never lost sight of his aim to advance understanding of the** classical dance form.**
 
• He founded the** Govindji Nartanalaya dance** school for women in Imphal and the Manipuri Nartanalaya dance school in Calcutta in 1972 as part of this **endeavour.**
 
• **Kuchipudi is** one of the eight major Indian classical dances. The founder of **Kuchipudi dance is Shri Siddhendra Yogi.** He has developed his skills and polished Kuchipudi dancing techniques along with** other esteemed academics and artists.**​
 
• In the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh, the village of** Kuchelapuram is where Kuchipudi gets its name. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj **represented the Lucknow **"Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana of Kathak dance** in India as a performer, composer, and singer.
 
• Legendary Indian classical dancer, mentor, and representative of the** Odissi dance, Kelucharan Mohapatra.**
 
• Indian dancer** Uday Shankar **is most recognised for inventing the** fusion form of dance. **
